label: Eggs, size 4 (55-60g), dozen
source_title: RPI: Ave price - Eggs: size 4 (55-60g), per dozen
adjustment: Original (not seasonally adjusted unless stated in title)
methodology: RPI average price series (published by ONS in dataset MM23). Annual figure as published by ONS. Prices are for a specified item and pack size, not a market-wide census.
limitations: Product specification and pack sizes change over time; the series may be discontinued. RPI is not a National Statistic; average-price quotes are indicative.
